scope: one fixed target-extension ablation on previously examined Farm A; exploratory, not independent holdout
baseline_policy: reuse all four frozen baseline regressors and calibration; train only four added regressors with identical hyperparameters, roles, history and fitting rules
quality_policy: nonfinite becomes missing; no interpolation; delay exactly 10 minutes, reset on missing timestamp; preserve observed finite extremes including 205 because no verified physical bounds are available
power_policy: keep power_29 and its original numeric scale; power_30 will be a separate experiment
threshold_policy: recalibrate maximum positive residual across eight targets, same 3-hour smoothing and same certified historical normal calibration; never tune on prediction outcomes
promotion_gate: more than four new event detections, false episode rate <=2/720h, normal warning fraction <=5%, availability at least baseline minus 0.01
episode_policy: inherit all 11 canonical events including missing predictions, count new below-to-above crossings in the last 24 hours
score_semantics: normal temperature deviation, not calibrated failure probability or future temperature prediction
